message.content:
The copy constructor now uses a member-initializer list so `values` and `stringIndexes` are copy-constructed directly, avoiding the previous default-construct-then-`operator=` sequence (which zero-initializes each vector and re-checks capacity before allocating).

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values), stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
